title: The Product Photo Mistake Amazon FBA Sellers Make in Every Category (Fix This Weekend)
description: Every Amazon FBA seller makes this one photo mistake. Fix it this weekend and watch your rank climb.

blocks.text: Amazon FBA sellers obsess over keywords, PPC bids, and backend fields. But most ignore the single biggest conversion lever available: their main product image.
Here's the mistake almost every FBA seller makes.
The Mistake
Using the manufacturer/supplier's stock photo as your main image.
Just about every Alibaba supplier provides "professional" product photos. Sellers upload them directly. Which means 20-100 other Amazon sellers are using the exact same photo for the same product.
Amazon's algorithm doesn't know who to prioritize. Buyers can't distinguish sellers. Rank suffers.
Why This Kills Your Listing
Amazon actively deprioritizes duplicate images. If your main photo is a reverse-image match for 50 other listings, you're competing on price alone. And someone will always undercut you.
Also: manufacturer photos are often:
The Fix
Take your own photos. Even with a phone. Even in your kitchen.
Then:
Your images are now unique to your listing. Amazon's algorithm treats you as a distinct product, not a duplicate.
Use Rights-Safe Source Images

If a source image contains a watermark, obtain an unwatermarked file from the rights holder or create your own photo. edit-photo does not remove watermarks, and removing ownership marks without permission can create legal and marketplace risks.
Long term, always shoot your own.
The Enhanced Brand Content Angle
If you're brand-registered on Amazon, you have access to A+ Content and Enhanced Brand Content. These sections rank your listing higher and convert 5-10% better.
They require:
All buildable from transparent PNG masters at edit-photo.com. One shoot = full A+ Content library.
The Split-Test Reality
Serious FBA sellers split-test their main images. Amazon offers "Manage Your Experiments" for this.
Which means: You need at least two versions of your main image to test. Both must be unique to you, both compliant, both compelling.
Prepare test variants at edit-photo.com.
The Full FBA Photo Requirement
For every ASIN:
Nine images. All from consistent master files. All standardized through edit-photo.com.
The Weekend Fix
This weekend, pick your top 5 FBA products. Shoot new photos (phone is fine). Edit through edit-photo.com. Upload.
Watch your rank over the next 30 days.
Start Winning FBA
Duplicate images are the silent killer. Fix yours free at edit-photo.com.
